description:
AI Operations Specialist

About Us:
TechFlow AI is a Series B AI operations company building workflow automation platforms for enterprise. We're at an inflection point in our growth and need someone to build our operational excellence function from the ground up.

Role Overview:
We're seeking an AI Operations Specialist to own process optimization, workflow automation, and tooling across our operations team. You'll design and implement AI-driven workflows, integrate third-party APIs, manage our automation stack, and serve as the bridge between business requirements and technical execution. This role reports directly to the VP of Operations and has high visibility across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design and implement automated workflows using AI agents and API integrations
- Build and maintain operational dashboards and tracking systems
- Evaluate, integrate, and optimize tools and platforms (CRM, analytics, communication tools)
- Document processes and create runbooks for team efficiency
- Partner with leadership to identify and prioritize automation opportunities
- Manage the operations automation tech stack (5-10 tools)
- Mentor the operations team on workflow optimization and AI capabilities

Required Experience:
- 5+ years in operations, business operations, or process improvement roles
- Experience with workflow automation tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar)
- Proficiency with APIs and integration platforms
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Comfortable with ambiguity and building solutions with limited direction
- Experience working at growth-stage startups

Nice to Have:
- Python scripting or basic programming ability
- Experience with AI/LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.)
- Background in recruiting operations or talent acquisition
- Experience building dashboards (Looker, Tableau, or similar)
- Experience with CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot)

Compensation & Benefits:
- Salary: $110,000 - $140,000 (based on experience)
- Equity (0.1 - 0.3% depending on level)
- Comprehensive health, dental, vision
- Unlimited PTO
- Remote-friendly (1 day/week in-office preference)
- Budget for professional development

Why This Role Matters:
As we scale, operations become increasingly critical. You'll build the automation infrastructure that enables our team to move faster, reduce manual work, and scale efficiently. This is a high-impact role with visibility to the executive team and direct influence on company operations.
